canonicalJSON.definition: RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes encoded as UTF-8

invalidIJSON.name: duplicate_property_names
invalidIJSON.reason: JSON objects must not exhibit duplicate property names.

invalidIJSON.name: lone_surrogate_string
invalidIJSON.reason: JSON string data must be valid Unicode and lone surrogates must be rejected.

invalidIJSON.name: nonfinite_ieee754_number
invalidIJSON.reason: Conversion to IEEE 754 double precision produces a non-finite value.

invalidIJSON.name: duplicate_decoded_property_names
invalidIJSON.reason: Decoded JSON object member names must be unique.

invalidIJSON.name: direct_noncharacter
invalidIJSON.reason: I-JSON strings and object member names must not include Unicode noncharacters.

invalidIJSON.name: escaped_noncharacter
invalidIJSON.reason: I-JSON rejects Unicode noncharacters in escaped string data.

canonicalRON.definition: Compact RON for an RFC 8785 and I-JSON value. It uses the RON grammar and canonical RON string rendering.
canonicalRON.valueConstraints: RFC 8785 Section 3.1 and RFC 7493 Section 2.1. Reject duplicate decoded object names, invalid Unicode, Unicode noncharacters, and source numbers whose IEEE 754 double-precision conversion is non-finite. Finite source numbers can round during conversion.
canonicalRON.numberSerialization: ECMAScript JSON.stringify number serialization required by RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3.
canonicalRON.stringSerialization: Use the RON canonical string renderer after RFC 8785 string validation. Do not normalize Unicode.
canonicalRON.objectKeyOrder: RFC 8785 UTF-16 code unit order, recursively.
canonicalRON.inputMemberTracking: Canonical input parsing must retain ordered object members and decoded names until duplicate-name validation completes. Do not collapse a base RON last-wins object before canonical validation.
